questions.q1: How do I run this starter kit?
questions.q2: How does the demo login work?
questions.q3: How do I connect a real backend?
questions.q4: How do I change the theme?

answers.a1: Install dependencies and run the development server. No backend is needed — the mock API simulates auth and data locally.
answers.a2: Any email and password works, and 123456 for all OTP screens.
answers.a3: Open lib/api/config.ts for the axios client and replace the method bodies in lib/api/index.ts with real network calls. Method names stay the same.
answers.a4: Open Settings and choose Light, Dark, or System. The choice persists across restarts.
